analysis.title: Network Thoughts: Damp Equity Sentiment; But Year-End Chase Possible
key_insights: The FOMC held rates at 4.0% in a 10-2 vote. The statement upgraded economic activity from 'solid' to 'strong' and outlined strategy-focused meetings in 2027 and 2028. The December stub rallied 3bp and the USD weakened broadly across G10 during the press conference.
UBS Economics expects 25bp Fed hikes in December and January, taking the federal funds rate to 4.50%, followed by a prolonged hold.
Hedge funds were significant USD sellers ahead of the FOMC, with 10-day cumulative net flows at -2.1 sigma.
Weakness in large-cap growth, tech and AI-related stocks coincided with a sharp rally in rates, showing a shift in cross-asset correlations.

Tech sold off further on Friday after a volatile week. Alphabet, Amazon and Intel drove idiosyncratic weakness. Software came under pressure after disappointing results from ServiceNow, Fortinet and Twilio. Microsoft's beat-and-raise and supportive Oracle commentary did not restore confidence in the AI trade.
Tech fell roughly 6% in October. The open question is whether hyperscaler AI capex can offset mixed earnings and help the sector find a floor.

Positioning points to a tactical tech rebound: hyperscaler de-grossing has resumed, short exposure is above the 80th percentile over five years, and SOX is down 14% month to date. UBS sees scope for a short-covering rally even if tech stays rangebound.

November is historically the S&P 500's strongest month, averaging +1.9% since 1950, with only one negative November in the past decade. The S&P has been higher six months after every midterm since 1950.
Low net exposure and multi-year-high gross exposure create scope for a year-end performance chase. Weaker oil, lower VIX and MOVE, and falling 10y yields add support.

Markets price limited election risk. The SPX one-day implied move for Wednesday fell to 70bp from 90bp last week. EURUSD event premium has declined and Nov. 4 TLT options show no obvious kink. Nov. 6 SPX ATM vol is near 12, so downside protection through next week is relatively cheap, especially given the risk of concurrent Iran escalation.

The ECB (Lagarde) said it has tools to ensure smooth transmission of monetary policy and that tighter financial conditions from high yields and wider spreads would weigh on growth and inflation if sustained. This gave French markets some comfort. A December ECB hike is forecast by UBS, with 21bp priced.
Lagarde will leave the ECB on Feb. 7, eight months early, to have more freedom to comment on French fiscal matters.

Lula won the Brazilian runoff with 74% of available second-round votes, defying polls, prediction markets and the UBS aggregator. BOVA11 fell 14.5% and SMAL11 fell 28.1%. USDBRL briefly traded above 5.60 before retreating toward 5.40, and rates moved from pricing cuts to hikes.

In Brazil, implied vol has declined and skew is flatter. UBS likes put buying to hedge upside exposure, including the December 93.5% IBOV put at a 0.75% premium, selective buying of oversold domestic cyclicals, and defensives. Fiscal uncertainty is the key overhang.

An estimated $63bn traded at Thursday's close in the first leg of TOPIX's rebalancing, Japan's largest index rebalance. Membership will increasingly reflect liquidity, investability and free-float-adjusted market cap. The BoJ held rates today and a December hike is expected.

tension_points.bull_case: Short exposure above the 80th percentile over five years, hyperscaler de-grossing, SOX down 14% MTD and resilient AI capex create scope for a short-covering rally, helped by favorable November seasonality.
tension_points.bear_case: Mixed earnings from Alphabet, Amazon, Intel, ServiceNow, Fortinet and Twilio, plus a hawkish Fed with hikes expected, kept pressure on tech. Even Microsoft's beat-and-raise did not restore confidence.
tension_points.what_invalidates: Hyperscaler AI capex failing to offset mixed earnings, so tech does not find a floor.

tension_points.bull_case: November is the S&P's strongest month at +1.9% on average, the S&P is higher six months after every midterm, and low net with high gross exposure sets up a performance chase.
tension_points.bear_case: Damp equity sentiment, a hawkish Fed with hikes expected, and the risk of concurrent Iran escalation around the midterms.
tension_points.what_invalidates: An Iran escalation concurrent with the midterms.
